question_en: With the shutter closed, take one dark frame at 5% power and 1 second exposure.
answer: One file set; shutter == 'close' in the saved JSON.
setup: None. Even if the initial shutter is close, _effective_shutter opens it to auto when shutter_explicit=False, so the result is a dark frame only if the agent explicitly specifies close (discriminating).
todo_from_sheet: Fix the definition of dark as 'shutter close'. If written as 'laser off', acquire_spectrum turns the laser on atomically and the judgment does not hold.
